name: GLab
description: GLab is Guang’s personal notebook for project stories, practical guides and field notes from networking, software, cybersecurity, AI, community technology and sustainable farming.

intro: GLab is my personal notebook for the work I build and the questions I’m learning to answer. It brings together project stories, practical guides, and notes from networking, software, cybersecurity, AI, and community technology.

Growing up in the hills of Manipur gave me a lasting interest in nature and the environment. I’m also interested in sustainable farming practices and in technology that supports local needs without losing sight of maintenance, resources, or the people and places involved.
profile.statement: I’m passionate about building a future where technology and nature coexist harmoniously.
profile.workLine: Projects with context, not just a demo.
profile.interestLine: Practical questions about systems, people, and the living world.
profile.background: GLab grew from an early interest in computer networks and wireless analysis into hands-on software and ISP operations work. It now documents projects, technical learning, cybersecurity, community technology, and an ongoing interest in environmental sustainability and locally suitable farming practices. The focus is practical work, honest status, and respect for the people and places affected by technology.
